gloss: chanting of poetry; recitation of Chinese and Japanese poems

definitions.explanation: The traditional art of reciting classical Chinese or Japanese poetry in a melodic, chanting style.

examples.japanese: {祖父|そふ}は{吟詠|ぎんえい}が{趣味|しゅみ}だ。
examples.english: My grandfather's hobby is poetry chanting.

examples.japanese: {文化祭|ぶんかさい}で{吟詠|ぎんえい}の{発表|はっぴょう}が{行|おこな}われた。
examples.english: A poetry chanting performance was held at the cultural festival.

examples.japanese: {吟詠|ぎんえい}は{漢詩|かんし}や{和歌|わか}を{独特|どくとく}の{節回|ふしまわ}しで{詠|よ}む{日本|にほん}の{伝統芸能|でんとうげいのう}で、{腹式呼吸|ふくしきこきゅう}と{発声|はっせい}の{訓練|くんれん}にもなる。
examples.english: Ginei is a traditional Japanese performing art of reciting Chinese poems and waka with a distinctive melodic style, and it also serves as training in abdominal breathing and vocalization.

notes:
A compound of {吟|ぎん} (to recite, to chant) and {詠|えい} (to compose or recite poetry). Also called {詩吟|しぎん}, which is the more commonly used synonym in everyday speech.

This art form involves chanting classical {漢詩|かんし} (Chinese poetry) and {和歌|わか} (Japanese poetry) with a stylized melodic delivery. It remains popular as a hobby among older Japanese, with many local clubs and regional competitions.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {吟詠|ぎんえい}を{学|まな}ぶ: to study poetry chanting
- {吟詠|ぎんえい}{大会|たいかい}: poetry chanting competition
- {吟詠|ぎんえい}の{流派|りゅうは}: schools of poetry chanting

RELATED TERMS:
- {詩吟|しぎん}: poetry chanting (common synonym)
- {漢詩|かんし}: Chinese poetry
- {和歌|わか}: classical Japanese poetry
- {朗読|ろうどく}: reading aloud; recitation (modern, without melodic chanting)
